scope: Undergraduate bachelor majors and formal credentials/options across all three UW campuses. Graduate/professional non-bachelor degrees, minors and standalone certificates excluded.

definitions.catalogCredential: A distinct official Bachelor h4 credential anchor under a program-UG-…-MAJOR block; may be an option, location, pathway or dual-degree variant, not a distinct standalone major.
definitions.catalogListed: Present in current public catalog. This is not independent confirmation applications are open or a degree is still admitting.
definitions.available: Excludes only explicitly not-admitting titles. Confirm current admissions availability with the academic unit.
definitions.requirements: Exact official program and credential source sections, with readable paragraph/list breaks. Course mentions and numeric snippets are references, not a flattened audit or inferred prerequisite graph.
